current_point.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法Sketch-DBH，利用Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储节点度数信息，并使用最小堆维护高频节点信息，实现常数时间内返回查询结果并生成子图编号，确保负载均衡。
current_point.claim_en: Propose a graph flow partition algorithm Sketch-DBH based on edge segmentation, which uses the Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure to store node degree information and a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information, enabling constant-time query results and generating subgraph IDs while ensuring load balance.

technical_features: 基于边分割的图流划分算法
通过Count-Min Sketch概率数据结构存储每个节点的度数信息
使用最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息
在常数时间内返回查询结果
根据节点度数信息生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号
technical_features_en: Graph flow partition algorithm based on edge segmentation
Store node degree information using the Count-Min Sketch probabilistic data structure
Use a min-heap to maintain high-frequency node information in graph streams
Return query results in constant time
Generate the subgraph ID to which each graph stream item will be assigned based on node degree information
